decision: Exact full500 with modest aggregate benefit, but strict performance promotion by length fails: length111 median is0.259660ms/0.219%slower (both halves regress), length116 p95 is0.014144ms/0.0118%slower. Aggregate median/p95 improve0.724%/0.606%, and both halves improve. Preserve as a mixed result; keep accepted folded baseline/main performance docs unchanged. No repeat full500, adaptive length routing, or expanded capture. Next option is a separately justified bounded native FP32 backend diagnostic.
